subject: Scheduling: private deployment architecture review and next steps
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Sam Khan <sam.khan@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & scheduling: private deployment architecture review

Thanks again for taking time today, Sam — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align the technical review with your security team:

Key takeaways from discovery:
- Primary objective: host Redwood Inference in Aurelia's VPC (private deployment) with strict isolation.
- Must support HSM-backed key management, audit logs retention for 1 year, and fine-grained token/route controls.
- Expected steady-state: ~25 qps, spikes up to 150 qps during peak workflows.
- Primary concerns: network topology (VPC peering vs. transit), egress rules, and SOC2 evidence for data controls.

Next step (requested): technical architecture review / deep-dive (60–75 min) with Aurelia infra + security + our solutions engineering team to cover: network design options, KMS/HSM integration, monitoring/audit flows, and SLA/rollback/fallback behavior.

Proposed windows (PDT) — please confirm one that works or suggest others:
- Tue May 18, 2027 09:00–10:15
- Tue May 18, 2027 13:00–14:15
- Wed May 19, 2027 11:00–12:15

Attachments: Redwood-Private-Prep-Checklist.pdf (prep list for internal security/infrastructure), Network-Reqs-summary.xlsx (summary of required ports and CIDR expectations).

Please confirm attendees from Aurelia (we recommend including your security director and infra lead). Once you confirm a slot I’ll have Marcus or Soojin send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: Sam Khan <sam.khan@aureliahealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina.patel@aureliahealth.com>, Oliver Park <oliver.park@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 17:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & scheduling: private deployment architecture review

Thanks, Irene — good recap and exactly what we need to move forward.

A few quick notes from our side:
- Security will definitely want SOC2 artifacts (or where to access them) and any third-party pen test summary we have.
- Nina (cc’d) will attend to validate audit/logging retention and access controls.
- Oliver (cc’d) will join for network/topology discussion.

Our preferred times (EDT):
- Tue May 18, 2027 12:00–13:15 EDT (works for Nina and me)
- Wed May 19, 2027 14:00–15:15 EDT

If you can confirm a specific slot I’ll get calendar invites out on our side as well. Also please include a high-level agenda so I can circulate to leadership.

One more ask: can the deep-dive include a brief segment (~10 min) on how Redwood handles graceful degradation / fallback to smaller models when dedicated capacity is constrained? That’s a key question for our product team.

Thanks,
Sam Khan
Director of Product — Aurelia Health
sam.khan@aureliahealth.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sam Khan <sam.khan@aureliahealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & scheduling: private deployment architecture review

Hi Sam — Marcus here (Solutions Engineering). Happy to lead the technical deep-dive and cover the fallback/canary behaviors Sam called out.

We can accommodate the Tue May 18 slot corresponding to 12:00–13:15 EDT. Proposed final time: Tue May 18, 2027 09:00–10:15 PDT / 12:00–13:15 EDT.

Agenda (proposed, 60–75 min):
1) Intros & roles (5 min)
2) High-level architecture options: VPC peering, Private Control Plane, and on-prem connector (15 min)
3) Network/firewall & CIDR requirements (10 min)
4) KMS/HSM integration and key lifecycle (10 min)
5) Observability & audit logs (10 min)
6) Graceful degradation / model fallback and autoscaling behavior (10 min)
7) Q&A / next steps / action items (10–15 min)

I’ve added PrivDeploy-arch-diagram-v01.pdf to our prep bundle and will include a short walk-through during the meeting. Calendar link (for Redwood invite): https://redwood.app/calendar/evt/abc123

If Tue 12:00–13:15 EDT works, I’ll send the invite and include dial-in + Zoom and a shared drive folder for artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Aurelia-PrivPrep

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin

marcus.lin@redwood.com

Confirmed — thanks everyone. I’ve scheduled Tue May 18, 2027 09:00–10:15 PDT (12:00–13:15 EDT). Invite and meeting materials will go out shortly from Marcus.

Quick attendee list we have:
- Sam Khan (Aurelia) — Director of Product
